guide5: After publication, open applications and contributions from Guide. Money is contributed by paying, without waiting for approval: if the payer is signed in, their collaborator profile appears in the Collaborators inbox and you can see who paid. When you confirm receipt in Contributions, that profile is approved automatically and published if the person allowed it. You review and approve applications for V-Bucks, gift cards and gifts yourself. Approval does not confirm received prizes or a final place.
publicApplicationGuide: If applications are open, sign in and choose your own channel. Complete your contact, accept the requirements and submit. You can check status, update or withdraw. Your profile is public only with your consent and the organizer’s approval. To offer V-Bucks, gift cards or gifts, send an application from “Collaborate”, accept the custody notice and, if you wish, allow the amount to be shown: you manage and deliver that offer yourself, and it is shown separately without being added to the prizes.
organizerNotice: Your application details go to the organizer of this call, not Epic Games.

funding.guide: In Contributions, record each receipt with a unique reference. Verify the net amount or units, allocate the prize portion and specify who administers and delivers it. Then confirm. If the payer was signed in, the contribution already comes linked to their collaborator profile and you can see who paid; if linking failed it is repaired automatically on confirmation, or you can link it with the application ID. Confirming a contribution also approves the profile created by that payment (public only with the person’s consent); if you later reverse it and no other confirmed contribution remains, the profile returns to pending. A payment without a session is shown as anonymous and creates no profile. Opening applications and opening contributions are independent. Test payments cannot be confirmed as prizes and never approve anyone.
funding.publicGuide: Available prizes come from contributions whose receipt and availability the organizer confirmed. They are shown separately by currency and type. Pending offers do not count. You can contribute money from the call itself with “Collaborate”, without waiting for approval: without a session your contribution is anonymous; signed in, you can appear with your channel once the organizer confirms receipt, and you can see your contributions under “My contributions”. Payment does not purchase benefits or automatically confirm a prize. The organizer sees who contributed while signed in so they can manage it; your contact and payment details are not published.

funding.noticeActive: The custody notice is active: it is shown when offering V-Bucks, a gift card or a gift (with mandatory acceptance and a separate checkbox to show the amount) and next to each public offer. Money paid through the payment flow is received and administered by you. The notice text cannot be edited from this panel.

collaborationNext.title: Application approved: continue with your contribution
collaborationNext.moneyHelp: You can make your contribution here. At checkout you choose a reference USD amount and review the PEN charge; the amount offered in your application is not charged automatically. Approval and payment are separate steps.
collaborationNext.receiptHelp: If you already paid, check the receipt before contributing again. The link restores the receipt saved in this same browser tab; it cannot determine whether you paid in another tab or on another device.
collaborationNext.closedHelp: New contributions through the payment gateway are closed. You can check an earlier receipt; the organizer must open contributions before you can start a new one.
collaborationNext.deliveryHelp: For a card or gift, first coordinate delivery with the organizer. An approved application records your offer; the organizer must verify receipt and availability before adding it to prizes.
collaborationNext.followReview: Follow the instructions the organizer left in your application comment. Do not enter card codes or delivery details in public fields.
collaborationNext.awaitInstructions: Check your application comment here for the organizer’s delivery instructions. No instructions have been left yet; use “Reload my application” to check for updates.
collaborationNext.reviewHelp: The applicant can read this comment in their application. When approving gift cards, V-Bucks or gifts, explain how to arrange delivery privately: the contributor manages and delivers those offers. New money does not go through here: it is contributed by paying and confirmed in Contributions. Approval does not start a payment or send a notification.
collaborationNext.guide: Money needs no approval: the person presses “Collaborate”, pays and, if signed in, their collaborator profile is created automatically and approved when the organizer confirms receipt. For gift cards, V-Bucks or gifts they send an application with the custody notice; after approval they can return to the call and reload their application to see the coordination instructions in the organizer’s comment, which must give a private delivery method during review. No automatic notification is sent: status is visible when they return to the page. Anyone who already paid can check their contribution under “My contributions” before contributing again. Approval does not prove receipt or availability for prizes.

custody.title: Custody notice
custody.notice: Contributions of V-Bucks, gift cards or gifts remain in the custody of the contributor who offers them, who manages them and delivers them to the winner under what they agree. The organizer and Decatron display the information the contributor declares, but do not hold or deliver these prizes and are not responsible for how the contributor manages them. Money contributions made through Decatron's payment flow are received and administered by the organizer.
custody.accept: I understand and accept this notice: I manage and deliver my contribution
custody.publicOffer: I allow the amount I offer to be shown publicly
custody.publicOfferHelp: This is separate from the profile consent: unchecked, your profile may appear but not the amount.
custody.publicOfferNeedsListing: To show the amount you must first allow your public profile.
custody.offerHelp: This records an offer under your custody, not a transfer. The organizer does not receive or deliver V-Bucks, gift cards or gifts.
custody.tabHelp: For V-Bucks, gift cards and gifts you send an application and the organizer approves it. Money is contributed in the other tab, without waiting for approval.
custody.declaredNotAdded: Amounts declared by each contributor. They are not added to the available prizes or mixed with money.
custody.vbucksNote: V-Bucks cannot be gifted directly in Fortnite. Only items currently in the Item Shop or gift cards can be gifted; gifting requires two-factor authentication, level 2 or higher, a friendship of at least 2 days and a maximum of 5 gifts per 24 hours.
